All done. Summary:

1. **Investigated deploy history**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback status confirms the service is healthy with a low error rate (~0.2%).
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the health check failures and the rollback. The first attempt timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to avoid duplicate incidents.

Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains to be investigated by the on-call engineer.
